technical_and_design_decisions: Use the existing Spring XD codebase (based on Spring Framework) for all implementations.
For U1 (Kafka pipeline), leverage Spring Integration Kafka adapter for message bus integration and implement sample topologies for log aggregation and lambda architecture.
For U2 (Sqoop batch), use Spring Batch with Sqoop integration to create JDBC-to-HDFS and HDFS-to-JDBC examples.
For U4 and U5 (Storm/Spark Streaming comparisons), create documentation and equivalent sample applications using Spring XD's stream processing capabilities.
For U8 (file sink name expression), extend the existing file sink module by adding a new --nameExpression option that delegates to the filename-generator-expression attribute using SpEL.
All new samples will be added to the Spring XD samples repository with appropriate Gradle build configuration.
Documentation will be written in AsciiDoc to match existing project conventions.
assumptions: The developer is already familiar with Spring XD internals, Gradle build system, and the technologies involved (Kafka, Sqoop, Storm, Spark Streaming, Hadoop).
Development environment is set up with necessary dependencies (Kafka cluster, Hadoop/HDFS, Sqoop, etc.) and requires no additional setup time beyond what is included in the estimates.
All user stories are independent and can be developed sequentially; no dependencies between them.
Testing includes unit tests, integration tests (using embedded or local instances where possible), and validation of sample functionality.
Code review and merging are part of the development process and included in the effort estimates.
The effort estimates are for a single developer working full-time (8 hours per workday) with no interruptions.
The existing codebase is stable and well-documented, requiring minimal learning curve.

Create a Spring XD batch sample using Sqoop for JDBC-to-HDFS and HDFS-to-JDBC data movement. Include Spring Batch job definitions, configurations, and documentation.
Modify the Gradle build scripts to remove the pushGeneratedDocs task and eliminate unnecessary link rewriting as specified in U3. Verify that documentation generation still works correctly.
